title: verify/store: identity=None binds NULL to NOT NULL column, silently drops failed verifications
description:
## Bug

In VerificationStore::record_verifications(), ArticleVerification.identity is Option<String>. When identity is None (Fail, NoKey, ParseError results), the query binds None as SQL NULL. The article_verifications column is 'identity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''' — NOT NULL with empty-string default.

SQLite rejects the explicit NULL for a NOT NULL column, so the INSERT fails. The error is logged as a warning and silently dropped. Result: Fail, NoKey, and ParseError verification results are never persisted.

Impact: articles with forged/malformed signatures show no X-Stoa-Verified header instead of 'X-Stoa-Verified: fail'.

## Fix
In record_verifications: use v.identity.as_deref().unwrap_or("") to store empty string for None.
In get_verifications: convert Some("") back to None when reading back.
